author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Season of Hell's Legacy Gameplay Trailer for Diablo 4 and relive iconic battles or dive into waking nightmares. Diablo IV: Season of Hell's Legacy begins September 15.
title: Diablo 4 - Official Season of Hell's Legacy Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Chevrolet Corvette C1 trailer for The Crew Motorfest, the hit action racing game developed by Ubisoft. Players can now get behind the wheel of this 1953 sports machine, considered to be the first GM sports car. Collect coins and go for the win with Rayman Racer in The Crew Motorfest, available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: The Crew Motorfest - Official Chevrolet Corvette C1 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Lance Boosted Action in this latest Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance trailer for the upcoming action RPG expansion. The new trailer spotlights the Lance and breaks down its Boosted Action, featuring the slam & charge with the Boost Driver, sending back hits with greater force, and high-velocity pokes. Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.
title: Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance - Official Lance Boosted Action Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Dice’n’Go, a tactical race game developed by Pupworx where a good plan lasts until an opponent interferes. There’s a game board in front of you. It’s your turn to roll the dice. Somewhere ahead is the finish line, and your goal is simple: get there first! Dice’n’Go is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Dice’n’Go - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Talebound Story trailer for World of Warcraft, the legendary MMO RPG developed by Blizzard Entertainment. As Midnight approaches in Azeroth, Talebound looms. Take your place in Quillgrave and survive the night. Make it through this new special game mode, and you just may earn rewards untold. May you find riches in Talebound, good Champion. Talebound is coming soon.
title: World of Warcraft - Official Talebound Story Trailer
